lore:
Zenestra’s Zealots

For all the terrible potency of its cannons and Cogforts, faith is the bedrock of the Sigmarite war machine. Few beings represent that belief as much as Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel. Several times has she been recorded as slain, only to manifest anew wherever the need of the God-King’s folk is greatest.

Faithful Escort

Zenestra selects the most pious Freeguild Marshals and their Command Corps to accompany her, tempering the righteous fury of the Steelhelms with tactical nous. Full of zealous drive, these stubborn souls would rather perish than fail their saintly leader.

Spearhead Force

Shadowy Whisperblades, relic envoys, and fanatical infantry — Zenestra’s Zealots fight as if the Great Wheel itself turns upon their courage.

armyRules.name: SHADOWY SPYMASTER
armyRules.description: Whisperblades ensure that their masters are omniscient and their enemies oblivious. Your Whisperblade is not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, from the second battle round onwards, it can use the SUDDEN AMBUSH ability in your movement phase: set up this unit within 6" of an enemy unit and not in combat.

armyRules.name: LADY OF THE WHEEL
armyRules.description: Zenestra’s followers will defend her with a strength that can cow even a follower of the Dark Gods. Effect: Each time a friendly model is slain by a combat attack, roll a number of dice equal to that model’s Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

effects.description: When friendly models are slain by combat attacks, roll dice equal to Health; each 5+ inflicts 1 MD on the attacking unit after FIGHT

regimentAbilities.name: FERVENT RUSH
regimentAbilities.description: Singing righteous hymns and prepared to give their lives for the cause, these Sigmarites charge forward to battle. Declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability. Effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities this turn even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.

effects.description: Unit can CHARGE after RUN in the same turn

regimentAbilities.name: FIERCE ZEALOTS
regimentAbilities.description: Should Zenestra demand it, these followers will fight tooth and nail for even the meanest patch of dirt. Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly Freeguild Steelhelms units.

effects.description: +3 control to friendly Freeguild Steelhelms units

enhancements.name: DEVOUT COMMANDER
enhancements.description: This faithful commander strikes with a ferocity born of utter conviction. Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and the Rend characteristic of your general’s Master-forged Weapon.

ability.name: DEVOUT COMMANDER
ability.description: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and the Rend characteristic of this weapon.

enhancements.name: STAND FAST, COMRADES
enhancements.description: The general calls upon their soldiers to hold the line, no matter the cost and no matter the foe. Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-HERO unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target. Effect: The target has WARD (4+) until the start of the next battle round.

enhancements.name: STEP TO IT!
enhancements.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability for a non-HERO unit wholly within 12" of your general
enhancements.description: The Marshal tells their men to heft their weapons and get moving! Effect: Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that non-HERO unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.

enhancements.name: ARDENT DEMAND
enhancements.description: With a bellowed order, the Marshal ignites the passion and fury of the Freeguilders, and they lay into the enemy furiously. Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-HERO unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target. Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

spearheadComposition: General: Freeguild Marshal and Relic Envoy (Relic Envoy is a token)
Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel
1 Freeguild Command Corps Arch-Knight and Retinue

abilities.name: Shoot in Combat
abilities.description: This weapon can be used to shoot even while this unit is in combat.

abilities.name: MARSHAL’S ORDERS
abilities.description: The Relic Envoy rushes across the battlefield to hand-deliver a message. Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Effect: Remove this unit’s Relic Envoy token from the battlefield, then give it to the target.

abilities.name: RELIC ENVOY
abilities.description: Relic Envoys relay orders from the Freeguild Marshal to the soldiers of the line. Effect: While a friendly unit other than this unit has the Relic Envoy token, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit’s combat attacks. If this unit is destroyed, remove the Relic Envoy token from the battlefield.

units.name: Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel
units.imageUrl: images/cities_of_sigmar/Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel.png

abilities.name: VESSEL OF SIGMAR
abilities.description: Channelling the divine might of the God-King, Pontifex Zenestra is a powerful beacon of faith who bolsters the righteous and smites the corrupt. Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly or enemy units to be the targets. Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+: If it is a friendly target, it has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn. If it is an enemy target, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the roll.

abilities.name: FOREWARNED IS FOREARMED
abilities.description: The Whisperblade is both master spy and deadly assassin combined: the ultimate opportunist. Effect: While it is your turn, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST.

abilities.name: SUDDEN AMBUSH
abilities.description: The Whisperblade hides until it is the perfect moment to strike. (This unit is not set up during deployment; from the second battle round onwards it can use this ability.) Effect: Set up this unit within 6" of an enemy unit and not in combat.

units.name: Freeguild Command Corps Arch-Knight and Retinue
units.imageUrl: images/cities_of_sigmar/Freeguild Command Corps Arch-Knight and Retinue.png

abilities.name: UNIT COMPOSITION
abilities.description: This unit comprises 1 Arch-Knight, 1 Great Herald, 1 War Surgeon, 1 Soul Shepherd and 1 Mascot Gargoylian.

abilities.name: TALENTED CHAMPIONS
abilities.description: Each member of the Command Corps has their own special skills to be employed. Effect: After that command has been resolved, return the card to your hand. Designer’s Note: This allows you to either use the command a second time or score the battle tactic on that card as well.

abilities.name: FANATICAL FOLLOWERS
abilities.description: Such is the zealous frenzy that fills these warriors that even after suffering mortal wounds, they will drag themselves to their feet and continue to fight. Effect: Return 1 slain model to this unit.
